# Op catalog

Every kernel family `hk.ops` ships: the GPUs it runs on, what it takes, the engine routes that call it and the GPU tests that run it. Generated from `python/hk/ops/catalog.py` and the route table; `tests/hk/ir/test_ops_catalog.py` holds the catalog to the code. Signatures and docstrings: the [API reference](api/hk.ops.md). Which routes are on, per GPU: [supported hardware](supported-hardware.md#engine-routes-on-each).

| family | entry points | what | gfx1100 | gfx1201 | gfx942 | gfx950 | dtypes | engine routes (on by default) | GPU tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| elementwise | [`hk.ops.add`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsadd)<br>[`hk.ops.sub`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopssub)<br>[`hk.ops.mul`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsmul)<br>[`hk.ops.maximum`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsmaximum)<br>[`hk.ops.minimum`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsminimum)<br>[`hk.ops.exp`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsexp)<br>[`hk.ops.relu`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsrelu)<br>[`hk.ops.gelu`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsgelu)<br>[`hk.ops.neg`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsneg)<br>[`hk.ops.abs`](api/hk.ops.md#hkopsabs) | one op an element: arithmetic and activations; register strips on gfx1100, gfx1201 and gfx950; tiles on gfx942 | yes | yes | yes | yes | bf16, fp16, fp32 (the kernels HipKittens specialises per op) | -- | `test_elementwise.py`, `test_cdna_rows.py` |

A family that runs on a GPU has a kernel there and is run by CI's GPU tier where it has a runner for that GPU; gfx942 builds only (no part was available). A route marked off is off by default; its switch turns it on without the validation ([integration](integration.md#on-by-default-and-turning-it-off)).
